verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's docs show guided document creation (150+ customizable legal documents, LLC/incorporation forms, operating agreements) and bundled attorney consultations for follow-up questions, implying some review path, but there is no explicit evidence of an in-flow questionnaire mechanism that flags specific answer choices needing attorney review. Community comments (e.g., a lawyer noting operating agreements are not commodities) suggest the templated approach may miss nuanced legal decisions that would warrant human review, without directly disputing the questionnaire's correctness. missing for 10: explicit description of the guided questionnaire UI/logic that flags risky choices, independent verification that flagged items are accurate or attorney-reviewed in real time.
